text: DSH Followup Prompt（DSH 网页插件）根据已完成的对话预测用户下一条可能发送的消息，并在空白输入框中显示。按 Tab 可将建议转成可编辑草稿，按 Escape 可关闭；用户始终自行编辑和发送。它适合希望更快继续对话的用户。默认沿用当前会话模型，也可在插件设置中选择其他提供方和模型。

DSH Followup Prompt (DSH web plugin) suggests a next message from the completed chat and displays it in the empty composer. Press Tab to make an editable draft; Escape dismisses it. You choose what to edit and send. It uses the session model by default, or a provider and model selected in settings.
想让 DSH 根据刚结束的对话，帮我起草下一条要发的消息。
有没有办法在输入框里看到一条可编辑的后续回复建议？
Show an editable follow-up draft in the empty chat composer.
DSH Followup Prompt 的功能「下一条消息建议」：每轮对话完成后，根据用户消息和助手可见回复生成一个后续消息候选，并在空白 composer 中显示为提示；按 Tab 后成为可继续编辑的草稿。
DSH Followup Prompt 的功能「预测模型设置」：可在插件设置中选择 DSH 已配置的提供方和模型，或沿用会话默认模型，并调整推理强度、输出 token 上限、超时和提示词。

> Predicts your next message in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Press Tab to use it; it never sends by itself.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Followup Prompt：After each reply, the plugin guesses what you are most likely to say next and shows it as gray text inside the empty composer. Press **Tab** to turn it into an editable draft, or just start typing and it disappears.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Followup Prompt：- **Unobtrusive**: appears only when the composer is empty; failures and timeouts show nothing and never raise an error.
- **You stay in control**: a prediction is only a draft. You always send it yourself.
- **Works out of the box**: uses the current session's model by default, with no extra dependencies or services.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Installation：Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (verified on 0.2.1-rc.2) with at least one model configured.

**Harness Desktop (Windows, macOS)**

1. In the sidebar, open **Plugins** → **Add plugin**.
2. Enter `dsh-followup-prompt` as the **Package name or address**. In mainland China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**.
3. Click **Install**, then **Enable now**, and reload the page. If you are told to restart DSH, quit Harness completely and open it again.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Installation：If npm is unreachable, step 2 also accepts the full path of a `dsh-followup-prompt-<version>.tgz` downloaded from [Releases](https://github.com/keliwang/dsh-followup-prompt/releases).

**Harness Web (Windows, macOS, Linux)**

Requires Node.js `22.19` or later and pnpm.

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-followup-prompt
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 web
```

dsh-followup-prompt README · Installation：> [!NOTE]
> Do not install from the source directory (entering this repository's path as the package address). A directory install cannot find the dependencies that ship with Harness, so the plugin fails to load. To build locally, run `pnpm pack` in this repository and install the resulting `.tgz`.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Installation：**Verify the installation**: ask a question, wait for the reply to finish, and leave the composer empty. Gray prediction text appears in the composer; press Tab and the text moves into the composer **without being sent**. If no prediction appears, see the [FAQ](#faq).
dsh-followup-prompt README · Usage：When a reply finishes and the composer is empty, the prediction appears where the placeholder would be.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Usage：| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Tab** | The prediction becomes a draft in the composer with the cursor at the end, ready to edit |
| **Esc** | Closes this prediction; it does not come back for this turn |
| Start typing or composing with an input method | The prediction hides; once the composer is cleared, a prediction that was already generated reappears |
| Start a new turn or switch sessions | The prediction hides |

Reopening a finished session also shows the prediction for its last turn.

dsh-followup-prompt README · How it works：**What gets sent**: your messages and the visible text of the model's replies in this session. Thinking, tool calls, tool output, and the system prompt are left out.

**When it runs**: only when a turn has finished and you're looking at the session with an empty composer. The result is kept until the next turn starts, so viewing it again isn't billed again. Interrupted or failed turns, empty sessions, and subagent sessions are skipped.

dsh-followup-prompt README · How it works：**What it predicts**: a short reply to the model's latest message, based only on what's in the conversation. When there's nothing worth sending, like a plain "OK" or "thanks", or the next message depends on something only you know, such as a test result, no prediction appears. Predictions can still be wrong, so read one before you send it.

dsh-followup-prompt README · How it works：**Cost**: every prediction is an ordinary model request billed by your provider; with providers that support prompt caching, most of the input is billed at the cached rate. To spend less, pick a cheaper model for predictions in the settings; to stop entirely, switch the plugin off on the Plugins page.

**Privacy**

dsh-followup-prompt README · How it works：- Data goes only to the current session's model, or to the model you set with `provider` / `model`. Nothing is reported to any third party.
- Predictions live in memory only. They are never written to the session log or to disk, and are gone after a restart.
- Logs record metadata only (latency, token counts, outcome), never conversation content.
- There is no server-side content moderation. Predictions that look like secrets are dropped locally, and you always send a prediction yourself.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Configuration：On the **Plugins** page, find **Followup Prompt** in the **Installed** list and click its configure button to open the settings. Click **Save** when you're done; changes take effect right away, no restart needed.

The **Model** list shows the models you have already set up in DSH, the same ones you see when switching models in the composer. Pick **Session default** to use whatever model your current session is running.

To turn the plugin off, use the switch on its row in the Plugins list.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Configuration：If you are comfortable with profile patches, you can also edit this plugin's `config` directly.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> `config` in a patch is replaced as a whole, not merged. When editing by hand, write out every field even to change one; use this package's [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) as a reference. Saving from the settings page also rewrites the whole `config`.

dsh-followup-prompt README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` / `model` | `''` / `''` | The model used for predictions; both must be set together. Leave empty to follow the current session's model. Same as the **Model** option on the settings page. |
| `reasoningEffort` | `'low'` | One of `''`, `off`, `low`, `high`, `max`. `''` uses the model's default; the session's own setting is never inherited. |
| `maxTokens` | `8192` | Output token limit, reasoning tokens included. Actual output is usually short; the default leaves room for thinking. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout for one prediction, 2–30 seconds. |
| `prompt` | `''` | Advanced: replaces the built-in prediction instruction. |

dsh-followup-prompt README · FAQ：
No prediction ever appears - On the **Plugins** page, check that the plugin's switch is on. - With non-DeepSeek models, `reasoningEffort: 'low'` may not be supported; change it to `''`. - A prediction is given up when the model takes longer than `timeoutMs`; try a faster model or a lower `reasoningEffort`. - Predictions are not shown while the composer contains text or attachments.
Tab does nothing

dsh-followup-prompt README · FAQ：While the slash-command menu or another popup menu is open, Tab belongs to the menu. Close the menu and press Tab again.
The prediction is misaligned Where the prediction is drawn depends on the internal structure of the Harness composer, which can shift after a Harness upgrade. Please open an issue; until it is fixed, switch the plugin off on the Plugins page.
An older version was installed

dsh-followup-prompt README · FAQ：Harness installs plugins with pnpm, which by default holds back versions published very recently (`minimumReleaseAge`) and installs the previous version instead; the install result shows the version actually installed. Wait a while, then reinstall following the [upgrade](#upgrade-and-uninstall) steps.

</details>

dsh-followup-prompt README · Upgrade and uninstall：**Harness Desktop**: on the **Plugins** page, find **Followup Prompt** in the **Installed** list and click **Uninstall**. To upgrade, uninstall first, then install again following [Installation](#installation).

**Harness Web**:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-followup-prompt@latest   # upgrade
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web remove dsh-followup-prompt      # uninstall
```
dsh-followup-prompt README · Upgrade and uninstall：Reload the page afterwards, and restart Harness if needed. To pause the plugin temporarily, switch it off on the Plugins page.
